name: secret-guard
description: Keeps secrets out of the conversation: hides API keys and private keys before the model or the transcript sees them, and blocks reads of credential files and commands that print secrets

skipBypassedRows.title: Skip rows Security default sends past
skipBypassedRows.description: Stops the "session.append hook was skipped" notice by not checking the rows Claude Code's Security default sends past secret-guard. Turn it on only on a Team or Enterprise plan or with managed settings: elsewhere secrets in files added with @, summaries, hook notes and skill text stop being hidden. Messages that other tools add go unhidden on every setup. A plugin your organization manages that adds notes to the conversation can bring the notice back.
